title: Ordinal partition relation formalization in Lean 4

problemStatement.formal: \text{Prove that } \omega_1 \text{ is regular, a limit ordinal, uncountable, and that ordinal partition relations are monotone in the ordinal parameter.}
problemStatement.plain: Prove the basic structural properties of ω₁ and ordinal partition relations that enable the Erdős #1169 formalization: ω₁ is uncountable, a limit ordinal, regular; ω₁² has cardinality ℵ₁; and α → (β, k)² implies α → (γ, k)² for γ ≤ β.
